**Scope source:** GAIK_Wizard_V2_Sprint3-4_plan_20260907_v2.pdf — the Sprint 3 table agreed with the customer on 7 Sep 2026

**Definition of done:** For the use cases the customer provides, 5 of 5 generate a PoC that runs in the sandbox and produces the correct output. The sandbox half is Sprint 4; Sprint 3 owns 'a runnable PoC package is generated and downloadable'.

**Coverage of 24 criteria:** 19 have a check that runs on every PR · 5 are covered only at a deeper level that does not run per PR · 0 have no evidence at all.

Covered only outside the PR build — a green CI does not speak for these:

- Browser verification: a manually chosen tab is replaced by the right one when the milestone is crossed (🌙 nightly)
- Verified end to end from the first prompt through to Gate 3 (🖐 manual)
- Generated artifacts do not mix Finnish and English (🖐 manual)
- PR #137 merged (🖐 manual)
- A reject straight after a change request still records (🌙 nightly)

## How each level runs

| Level | Command | Runs |
|---|---|---|
| Unit (vitest) | `npm run test` | ✅ every PR |
| wizard_api (pytest + Postgres) | `cd ../wizard_api && pytest` | ✅ every PR |
| solution_wizard (pytest) | `cd ../solution_wizard && pytest -q` | ✅ every PR |
| E2E against the mock store (Playwright) | `npm run test:e2e` | ✅ every PR |
| E2E against the real stack (Playwright + wizard_api + Postgres) | `npm run test:stack` | 🌙 nightly / on demand |
| E2E against the live agent (Playwright + Claude login) | `npm run test:e2e:agent` | 🖐 manual |
| Use-case acceptance run | `npm run test:e2e:uc` | 🖐 manual |
| Recorded fact (git history, deploy, review) | — | 🖐 manual |

All commands are run from `implementation_layer/solution_wizard_v2`.

## Use-case acceptance (the customer's own measure)

Fixtures live in the customer use-case bundle outside this repo. A use case counts as
verified when a run of the wizard against its fixture produces a PoC package and the
run artifacts are stored beside the fixture.

| Use case | Fixtures | Run recorded |
|---|---|---|
| **UC01** — Finnish voice fault reports → maintenance tickets | `fixtures/UC01` | `runs/UC01` |
| **UC02** — Purchase order PDFs → ERP records (VisionExtractor) | `fixtures/UC02` | `runs/UC02` |
| **UC03** — Role-aware RAG assistant with citations | `fixtures/UC03` | `runs/UC03` |
| **UC04** — Multi-source report generation | `fixtures/UC04` | `runs/UC04` |
| **UC05** — Meeting: audio + agenda PDF + participant JSON | `fixtures/UC05` | `runs/UC05` |

**5 of 5** use cases have a recorded run.
